techs.name: Halo Spire
techs.label: HALO
techs.description: Unlocks the Halo Spire, a support tower whose shield stops the enemy projectiles. Also needs Masonry Guild at max level.

techs.name: Warding Halo
techs.label: WARD
techs.description: Halo Spire shields: +10% of the wall max HP as shield HP and +10% of the wall defense as shield defense per level. At max level the shields have 60% / 80% / 100% of the wall HP and defense (Halo Spire level 1 / 2 / 3).

techs.name: Empowering Halo
techs.label: AURA
techs.description: Halo Spires add +6% of the base damage and +4% of the base attack speed per level to the closest towers (2 / 4 / 8 by Halo Spire level), before the % buffs. No stacking between halos.

techs.name: Mending Halo
techs.label: MEND
techs.description: Every 30 / 20 / 10 activations (Halo Spire level 1 / 2 / 3) a Halo Spire restores 0.5% / 1% / 2% of the missing wall HP. Time between two mends = activations needed / activations per second (the spire's attack speed): about 46 / 25 / 10 s at the base speed 0.65 / 0.8 / 1 per s, shorter with attack speed research. Several Halo Spires mend one after the other. Out of combat, after each wave, every Halo Spire also restores 5% / 10% / 15% of the wall max HP.

_docAwakening: 'requiresAll': the node needs every finite technology at max level, except itself, the nodes below it and the 'afterAwakening' ones. The tree draws it below a line of its own at the end of tier 3, the 'afterAwakening' nodes in the rows under it ('column': take the column of that technology).
